summary: With a stable 132-event set, positive source filters removed and restored auth (2), api (8), scrape (1), desktop (63), msg (56), and sys (2) events; other displayed sources remained. No current rows matched stream, pilot-stream, pilot, desktop-ws-offscreen, supabase, frontend-bridge, audio, sw, or ui, so those cases remain unverified. The info filter removed 126 events and success removed six; warn and error had no current positive rows and remain unverified. No reproducible defect was found.
